Limited (NSDL) (now Protean eGov Technologies Limited) was originally incorporated on 27 December 1995 under The enactment of [[Depositories Act|Depositories Act, December 1995]] by [[Government of India]], as [[National Securities Depository Limited|NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure Limited]], a depository registered with the [[Securities and Exchange Board of India]] (SEBI).{{Cite news |last=Rukhaiyar |first=Ashish |date=2018-05-05 |title='NSDL e-Gov's services dwarf those of depository' |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/nsdl-e-govs-services-dwarf-those-of-depository/article23787209.ece |access-date=2024-07-19 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}} In 1996, the company received a certificate for the commencement of business from the [[Registrar of Companies (India)|Registrar of Companies]] (RoC). It was the first and largest depository in India and has been involved in the development and implementation of various technology infrastructure projects in the country.{{Cite news |date=2011-11-14 |title=Controversies in the life & time of ex-chairman of Sebi CB Bhave |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/controversies-in-the-life-time-of-ex-chairman-of-sebi-cb-bhave/articleshow/10722091.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-07-19 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} In 2004, the company launched initiatives such as the Tax Information Network (TIN), Pan Card Issuance, and Online Tax Accounting System (OLTAS). In 2005, it launched the Electronic Accounting System in Excise and Service Tax (EASIEST) and began managing it on behalf of the [[Indian Revenue Service|Central Board of Excise and Customs]].{{Cite news |date=2013-06-25 |title=NSDL demerges e-governance, Rao is new CEO |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/nsdl-demerges-e-governance-rao-is-new-ceo/articleshow/20753524.cms |access-date=2024-07-19 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} The company also manages the Tax Information Network (TIN) for the [[Income Tax Department]], [[Government of India]].{{Cite news |last=Motiani |first=Preeti |date=2022-12-05 |title=You cannot use accounts with these banks to pay income tax on TIN NSDL website anymore |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/wealth/tax/you-cannot-use-accounts-with-these-banks-to-pay-income-tax-on-tin-nsdl-website-anymore/articleshow/95505715.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-07-19 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} As part of this system, Protean facilitates the issuance of [[Permanent account number|Permanent Account Number]] (PAN) cards and enables electronic submission of [[Tax deduction at source|Tax Deducted at Source]] (TDS) returns, along with assisting banks in uploading tax payment data.{{Cite web |last=Narayanan |first=KS Badri |date=2023-11-07 |title=IPO screener: Protean eGov Technologies fully subscribed on Day 1 |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/ipo-screener-protean-egov-technologies-fully-subscribed-on-day-1/article67507107.ece |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Analyst report |url=https://www.sbisecurities.in/fileserver/research/reports/Protean%20eGov%20Technologies%20Limited_IPO%20Note.pdf |website=SBI securities}} In 2008, the company was appointed by the [[Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority]] (PFRDA) as the Central Recordkeeping Agency (CRA) for the [[National Pension System]] of the Government of India.{{Cite web |date=2021-12-10 |title=NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure rebranded as Protean eGov Technologies |url=https://www.techcircle.in/2021/12/10/nsdl-e-governance-infrastructure-rebranded-as-protean-egov-technologies |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=Techcircle |language=en}} The company has developed and implemented 19 projects across seven ministries in India. These projects included modernizing the direct tax infrastructure through initiatives such as [[Permanent account number|Permanent Account Number]] (PAN) issuance and the Tax Information Network and enabling a universal social security system for all Indians under the [[Atal Pension Yojana]].{{Cite web |title=Protean unleashes a digital renaissance |url=https://businessindia.co/magazine/protean-unleashes-a-digital-renaissance |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=businessindia.co |language=en}} In 2011, the [[Aadhaar|Unique Identification Authority of India]] (UIDAI) appointed the company as a Registrar for the implementation of the UID mission in India,{{Cite web |title=NSDL appointed as Registrar for UID |url=https://nsdl.co.in/pressrelease/NSDL-appointed-as-registrar-for-UID.php#:~:text=National%20Securities%20Depository%20Limited%20(NSDL,by%20Unique%20Identification%20Authority%20of}} and in 2013, the company launched [[Know your customer|e-KYC]] services. === Formation of NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure Ltd. === In 2012, NSDL transferred its depository business, including services under the Depositories Act, to its former subsidiary, NSDL Depository Limited. Later that year, in December, NSDL rebranded as NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure Limited as part of this business restructuring.{{Cite news |last=Rukhaiyar |first=Ashish |date=2018-05-05 |title='NSDL e-Gov's services dwarf those of depository' |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/nsdl-e-govs-services-dwarf-those-of-depository/article23787209.ece |access-date=2024-07-19 |work=The Hindu Protean eGov Technologies Limited === In 2021, the company rebranded itself to Protean eGov Technologies Limited and launched its subsidiary, Protean InfoSec Services Limited. In 2023, Protean received approval from the [[Reserve Bank of India]] (RBI) to operate as an Account Aggregator (AA).{{Cite web |date=2021-11-18 |title=NSDL e-Governance gets RBI's approval for account aggregator business |url=https://www.techcircle.in/2021/11/18/nsdl-e-governance-gets-rbi-s-approval-for-account-aggregator-business |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=Techcircle |language=en}} The company expanded its operations into the digital commerce sector by joining the [[Open Network for Digital Commerce]] (ONDC) and launched a marketplace called ''Rise with Protean'', which focuses on [[API]]s, [[microservices]], and related areas.{{Cite web |date=2023-12-13 |title=Protean launches marketplace for APIs and microservices |url=https://www.techcircle.in/2023/12/13/protean-launches-marketplace-for-apis-and-microservices |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=Techcircle |language=en}} In April 2024, 360 One WAM (formerly IIFL Wealth Management) sold a 5.3% stake in Protean through open-market transactions.{{Cite news |date=2024-06-13 |title=360 One acquires ET Money for Rs 366 crore to enter wealth tech space |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/360-one-acquires-et-money-to-enter-wealth-tech-space/articleshow/110947377.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-07-19 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} Protean finished its initial public offering (IPO) in November 2023 and was added to the BSE and NSE. == Partnerships == Protean was a founding member in establishing [[Open Network for Digital Commerce|ONDC]] under the [[Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade]] (DPIIT)'s leadership.{{Cite news |date=2023-06-29 |title=Protean eGov and NPCI Bharat BillPay partner to offer decentralised settlement system on ONDC |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/protean-egov-and-npci-bharat-billpay-partner-to-offer-decentralised-settlement-system-on-ondc/articleshow/101340846.cms |access-date=2024-07-19 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}{{Cite web |title=Protean unleashes a digital renaissance |url=https://businessindia.co/magazine/protean-unleashes-a-digital-renaissance |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=businessindia.co |language=en}} In 2023, Protean announced a collaboration with [[Google Cloud]] to deploy DPI across public and private sectors.{{Cite web |date=2023-08-23 |title=Protean joins forces with Google Cloud to develop DPI and Generative AI solutions |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/business/digital-transformation-protean-joins-forces-with-google-cloud-to-develop-dpi-and-generative-ai-solutions-3220394/ |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=Financialexpress |language=en}} Protean teamed up with [[Bharat Bill Payment System|NPCI Bharat BillPay]] (NBBL) to develop a decentralized settlement system for participants in digital commerce.{{Cite news |date=2023-06-29 |title=Protean eGov and NPCI Bharat BillPay partner to offer decentralised settlement system on ONDC |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/protean-egov-and-npci-bharat-billpay-partner-to-offer-decentralised-settlement-system-on-ondc/articleshow/101340846.cms |access-date=2024-07-19 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} In 2024, Protean signed an agreement with [[ArcelorMittal]] [[Nippon Steel]] [[India]] (AM/NS India) to support the '[[Beti Bachao Beti Padhao|Beti Padhao]]' scholarship initiative across multiple states in India. This initiative, started in March 2022 by AM/NS India, focuses on supporting underprivileged young women.{{Cite news |date=2024-03-09 |title=AM/NS, Protean continue 'beti padhao' scholarship pursuit - Construction Week India |url=https://www.constructionweekonline.in/people/am-ns-protean-continue-beti-padhao-scholarship-pursuit |access-date=2024-07-19 |work=Construction Week India |language=en-US}} == Initiatives == In its 2015 Budget speech, then [[Ministry of Finance (India)|Finance Minister]] [[Arun Jaitley]] announced that the government would create a single-window electronic platform for providing education loans under the Pradhan Mantri Vidya Lakshmi Karyakram. VidyaLakshmi is an online platform for students seeking education loans.{{Cite news |last=Rukhaiyar |first=Ashish |date=2018-05-05 |title='NSDL e-Gov's services dwarf those of depository' |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/nsdl-e-govs-services-dwarf-those-of-depository/article23787209.ece |access-date=2024-07-19 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}} It was developed by Protean in 2015 under the guidance of the Department of Financial Services ([[Ministry of Finance (India)|Ministry of Finance]]), the [[Department of Higher Education (India)|Department of Higher Education]] (Ministry of Education), and the [[Indian Banks' Association|Indian Banks Association]] (IBA). By 2018, the platform had 34 banks and 86 loan schemes listed. Protean also launched another portal called Vidyasaarathi, which is an education scholarship initiative allowing underprivileged students to receive financial assistance through corporate-funded scholarships. Vidyasaarathi announced its partnership with [[Tata Housing Development Company|TATA Housing]]. In 2018, the company reported 28,000 registered students and nine participating companies, including ACC, Care Ratings, SNL Bearings, and Education Consultants of India.{{Cite news |last=Rukhaiyar |first=Ashish |date=2018-05-05 |title=‘NSDL e-Gov’s services dwarf those of depository’ |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/nsdl-e-govs-services-dwarf-those-of-depository/article23787209.ece |access-date=2024-07-15 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}} In March 2026, the company hosted the inaugural Protean Digital Disruptors Awards{{Cite web |last=www.ETBrandEquity.com |title=Protean Digital Disruptors 2026 recognizes leaders powering India’s next-gen financial ecosystem |url=https://brandequity.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/digital/protean-digital-disruptors-2026-recognizes-leaders-powering-indias-next-gen-financial-ecosystem/129670239 |access-date=2026-04-05 |website=ETBrandEquity.com |language=en}} in partnership with ETBrandEquity, recognizing leaders who utilize AI and DPI to drive systemic changes in the financial and regulatory sectors. == Awards == === 2024 === * Golden Peacock Award 2024 for [[Open Network for Digital Commerce|ONDC]]{{Cite web |title=Golden Peacock Innovative Product / Service Award (GPIPSA) - Protean eGov Technologies Limited is an Indian technology company headquartered in Mumbai. The company focuses on developing digital public infrastructure (DPI) and e-governance initiatives for various governmental bodies in India. 
It works with central and state governments across multiple sectors including Tax Services (PAN, TIN, eTDS), Social Security and Welfare (CRA for NPS & APY), ID and Data Stack, Open Digital Ecosystem, and Cloud. 
In 2011, the company was appointed as a registrar for the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) to issue Aadhaar numbers to residents of the country. The company holds a 97% market share in NPS and 100% in APY Pension schemes, and a 54% market share in PAN related services.
